How do I use it properly the very first time?
For your first melt with the Mini Mod, here’s the simple version:
Put it on a flat, stable surface near an outlet, away from curtains or loose papers. Keep the cord from hanging over an edge.
Make sure the silicone dish is seated in the warmer. You don’t need an extra liner.
Add 1–2 Fresh Cotton bears to the dish, then turn on the warmer and choose a timer setting. Starting with 3 hours gives you a chance to see how you like the scent.
When you’re done, let the wax cool and harden completely. Then lift out the silicone dish and pop the wax out—no scraping needed.
The Mini Mod’s cord depends on the color: some have a USB-C cord and included power adapter, while Blue Pearl, Marble, Seafoam, and Earth have a hardwired two-prong cord.
